name: xbrain-design
description: A general design plugin: named styles and themes, patterns and a glossary of their parameters, the decisions and hooks that make designs strong with how to build them, choosing a direction by the product's type, UX rules and checklists, motion, design systems with Cyrillic type and accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA). The XBrain brain's own design skills (brain-design and its family) ship with XBrain's core plugin, not here.
